risk_note: RV2 by path (catalog and agent; money review). D10-664 S-08, 08 BR-TEXT-12 细则「购买按钮」: cta.text_key now follows the final rebate basis only — normal (single amount) and the no-longer-produced price_compare_risk → btn.buy.rebate, amount_unknown → btn.buy.rebate_unknown, login_required → rebate_login_to_view, no_rebate → btn.buy.no_rebate; btn.buy.coupon and btn.buy.rebate_suffix are no longer sent (keys kept); benefit_tags unchanged. ctaKeyFor (catalog/domain/card.ts) drops the coupon argument; catalog/index.ts exports it; the Agent search card recomputes the key from the final basis (incl. the guest login_to_view mask) and the rebate-quote card likewise. LinkLanding / share cards carry no cta by contract (client shows btn.buy) and are out of scope. The ProductCta contract text was already updated by CT-26t.
